verdict.rationale: Self-serve legal document automation is a fair question for a law firm, so the axis applies. The pack shows no interactive online document assembly. The notary page offers downloadable questionnaires and a GmbH starter kit, which are static forms the story explicitly excludes. ySolutions is a software-supported service for transparency-register filings, not founder-facing document assembly, and the legal-tech line is generic boilerplate.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm ships self-serve document automation — interactive assembly of real legal documents I can complete online, not just static templates
